decisions: Stable actual Calendar slot, exported DayButton and DayPicker classNames identify parts, never locale-formatted data-day values or native node IDs. Native 38/28/48px day sizes and 10px corners remain semantic role tokens; source 6px calendar-navigation corner is retained. Default 38px cells,8px root inset and explicit week/caption spacing make a reusable intrinsic calendar; compact 28px is an explicit data-calendar-size caller attribute, not a new upstream size prop. Calendar Root is unframed by default; a surrounding Popover/Card owns its frame. Optional dropdowns/week numbers and noninteractive mode retain actual source DOM. Native range/today/outside/disabled/hidden/selected states use actual DayPicker modifier classes and exported Button data-range attributes. One roving native day tabstop and an attached-ref components.DayButton reference repair preserve source handlers while fixing the pinned wrapper omission; unchanged raw wrapper remains a negative runtime regression. Date selection, keyboard focus, displayed month and caller validation remain separate. Local dates and meaningful names are explicit reference usage. No fixed specimen dimensions or universal AT claim.

Semantic token scalar values are meaningful reusable metrics, never coordinate-keyed specimen dimensions. Widths in native specimen grids remain evidence unless explicitly adopted as a domain layout constraint.
